{"id":1879152636,"question_id":3799,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"6 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1767903235,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1879152636/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Unique 3-Digit Even Numbers","memory":"31 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int totalNumbers(vector<int>& digits) {\n        int n = digits.size();\n        set<int>st;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i < n ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = 0 ; j < n ; j++)\n            {\n                for(int k = 0 ; k < n ; k++)\n                {\n                    if(i != j and i != k and j != k && digits[i] != 0 && digits[k] % 2 == 0)\n                    {\n                        int num = digits[i] * 100 + digits[j] * 10 + digits[k];\n                        if(num % 2 == 0)\n                        {\n                            st.insert(num);\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    return st.size();\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"unique-3-digit-even-numbers","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1463}
